data.gender_notes: Felicien is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'felix' meaning 'happy, fortunate'. This name is given to those who are believed to bring happiness and good fortune. The name Felicien carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful, Lucky” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Felicien usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful, lucky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes joy, happiness, and good fortune.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Felicien total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Saint Felicien of Cahors was a fifth-century bishop who is venerated as a martyr in the Diocese of Cahors, France. He is believed to have been born in the town of Albi and was the bishop of Cahors at the time of the Visigoth invasion in 411 AD. He was arrested for refusing to hand over the treasures of the church to the invaders, and was subsequently executed. His feast day is celebrated on May 27th.

Saint Felicien of Rome was a third-century martyr who is venerated in the Catholic Church. He is mentioned in various lists of early Christian martyrs, including the Martyrologium Hieronymianum and the Martyrologium Romanum. He is believed to have been a deacon in Rome during the persecution of Emperor Maximian in the late third century AD. He was arrested for refusing to offer sacrifice to the pagan gods, and was subsequently executed. His feast day is celebrated on September 16th.
